output_list.reason: The transferFrom function allows attackers to steal assets due to incorrect computations involving _value, aka the 'transferFlaw' issue.
The transfer function has an integer overflow, allowing attackers.FormState.setBalance('0') to be called, creating the issue.
The approve function has an owner argument, allowing attackers.FormState.setOwner(owner) to be called, creating the issue.
Integer overflow in enablePurchasing function allows unauthorized users to set owner as different user, change the balance of the user, and retrieve all the assets of the user.
Integer overflow in disablePurchasing function allows unauthorized users to change the balance of the owner, retrieve all the assets of the owner, and set the owner as different user.
Integer overflow in withdrawForeignTokens function allows unauthorized users to retrieve all the assets of the user and set the owner as different user.
Integer overflow in getStats function allows unauthorized users to retrieve the owner's balance, total contribution, total bonus tokens issued, and the purchasing status.
